title: HeteroWear: Sensor-Aware Self-Supervised Learning for Heterogeneous Wearable Activity Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2611.19027v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-supervised learning for wearable sensing is usually confined to a single dataset or device family, leaving open whether representations transfer across heterogeneous sensor configurations and whether gains come from pretraining rather than architecture or richer sensor input. We present HeteroWear, a sensor-aware self-supervised framework pretrained on an eight-dataset wearable corpus (173 subjects, 358,261 windows) spanning inertial and physiological signals across body locations, devices, and sampling rates. HeteroWear separates within-sensor temporal modeling from cross-sensor relational modeling using sensor-context embeddings, temporal and cross-sensor Transformers, and latent cross-attention fusion. Training combines structured sensor dropout, cross-configuration consistency, and per-axis masked sensor modeling; missing sensors are omitted rather than reconstructed. Under leave-one-dataset-out pretraining and subject-disjoin

translated_title: HeteroWear：面向异构可穿戴活动识别的传感器感知自监督学习
translated_abstract: 面向可穿戴传感的自监督学习通常局限于单一数据集或设备系列，这留下了一个悬而未决的问题：学习到的表征能否跨异构传感器配置进行迁移，以及性能提升究竟来自预训练本身，而非架构设计或更丰富的传感器输入。我们提出了HeteroWear，这是一个传感器感知的自监督框架，在一个涵盖八个数据集的可穿戴语料库（173名受试者，358,261个时间窗口）上进行预训练，该语料库横跨不同身体位置、设备和采样率的惯性信号与生理信号。HeteroWear利用传感器上下文嵌入、时间Transformer和跨传感器Transformer，以及潜在空间的跨注意力融合，将传感器内的时间建模与跨传感器的关系建模分离开来。训练过程结合了结构化传感器丢弃、跨配置一致性学习以及逐轴掩码传感器建模；对于缺失的传感器，直接省略而非重建。在留一数据集的预训练和受试者不重叠的评估设置下……
tldr: 提出了传感器感知的自监督框架HeteroWear，通过在包含八个数据集、173名受试者的异构可穿戴语料库上预训练，将传感器内时间建模与跨传感器关系建模分离，实现了可跨异构传感器配置迁移的活动识别表征。
en_tdlr: HeteroWear is a sensor-aware self-supervised framework pretrained on an eight-dataset heterogeneous wearable corpus that decouples within-sensor temporal modeling from cross-sensor relational modeling, enabling activity recognition representations that transfer across heterogeneous sensor configurations.
